name: hopper
description: Fastest LLM for voice agents: sub-100 ms time to first token, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text any agent can use with no sign-up.

interface.longDescription: The fastest LLM for voice agents: Hopper serves gemma-4-31b behind an OpenAI-compatible API with time to first token under 100 ms on a warm connection, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. In a voice-agent project the plugin gets a trial key with no sign-up, benchmarks your agent's own prompt, and switches the LLM once you say go (Pipecat, LiveKit Agents, Vapi, OpenAI SDK). It also finds what makes your agent pause, and gives your agent its own voice and ears: speak text aloud or transcribe a recording, with no account.
defaultPrompt: Make my voice agent respond faster with Hopper
Why does my voice agent pause before answering?
Say "Thanks for calling, how can I help?" in a Hopper voice
